newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ANZ CEO Mercer sees higher interest rates.
newsitem.headline: ANZ CEO Mercer sees higher interest rates.

text.p: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd chief executive Don Mercer said on Wednesday that Australian interest rates are likely to remain flat for a while but the next movement is likely to be up.

"I think our best expectation would be that interest rates are going to stay flat for a while and that the next movement in them will be in the context of a quickening economy, a move upwards," Mercer said in a radio interview.
When asked if he believed there would not be an upward movement until the end of 1997 Mercer said: "That would be the picture that I subscribe to at the moment."
The Reserve Bank of Australia eased monetary policy three times between July and December 1996, each time lowering its overnight cash rate target by 0.5 percentage points.
